pr.body: _Requested by **Fede** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GmFfDUHyfmqeFssJmCTNS8?thread=cmsg_01GmFfDUHyfmqeFssJmCTNS8TfuUbwCn5Md1PxksGCbYDK)_ ## What Follow-up to #123, from CodeRabbit's last incremental pass (posted after the merge). With a chosen `wallet` address, `contact_land_owner` compared the owner with that one wallet only, so a message to another wallet of the same account went through (the API only refuses the exact same address). The account's wallets are now read for the self-check on that path too; when they cannot be read (no `portfolio:read`), the chosen wallet alone is checked, as before. ## Tests - New assertion in `account-writes.test.ts`: a chosen sender with the owner as a second linked wallet is refused. The last test in that block sets its own profile instead of inheriting the previous test's. - `yarn typecheck`, `yarn test` (839), `yarn build` green locally. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_ --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Prevented contact requests from being sent to yourself when the property owner is linked to another wallet on your account, even if you select a different sender wallet. * Preserved the existing behavior of checking the selected wallet if other linked wallets can’t be retrieved.
